source.table: Table 1 — Estimated resident population, Statistical Areas Level 2, Australia
source.access_method: direct file_download, no bot protection (verified via plain curl)
source.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (standard ABS content licence)
source.data_type: observed Estimated Resident Population (ERP) — NEVER a projection, per ABS's own definition on the product page
source.geography_level: SA2 (Statistical Area Level 2) — the ABS's own recommended grain for this product, not suburb/postcode

validation.national_total_plausibility: 27,613,654 matches Australia's known 2025 population within expected range
validation.cross_validation_method: top-5 fastest-growing SA2s (population > 5,000) computed independently from the parsed data were compared against the ABS product page's own published narrative highlights
validation.cross_validation_result: PASS — Fraser Rise-Plumpton, Box Hill-Nelson, Tarneit-North, Virginia-Waterloo Corner, and Austral-Greendale all appear verbatim in both the independently computed top-5 list AND the ABS page's own 'areas with the largest growth' narrative text, confirming genuine correctness rather than coincidental plausibility

additional_source_downloaded_not_yet_par.description: Population estimates AND COMPONENTS (natural increase, internal migration, overseas migration) by SA2, 2024-25 only
additional_source_downloaded_not_yet_par.status: downloaded and confirmed genuine (Microsoft Excel 2007+), structure not yet parsed into the local store — reserved for a future pass if per-component (migration vs natural increase) breakdown is needed beyond total population growth

branch_promotion_status: NOT YET PROMOTED. This is SA2-grain data — no SA2-level mart table exists yet on the branch (SAL/POA are the only geography levels currently promoted). Promotion is deliberately deferred to Workstream 9, which owns the SA2/LGA canonical mart schema decisions, so this population layer becomes the SA2 mart's first real content rather than a one-off table built outside that workstream's scope.

not_used_this_pass.household_projections: explicitly not used — this sprint's hard rule forbids using projections in historical metrics; only observed ERP was sourced
not_used_this_pass.internal_overseas_migration_detail: the components file exists locally but detailed migration-vs-natural-increase attribution was not built this pass, only total population and its growth rate
